entries.question: Can explicit family IDs be recovered without trusting mutated local pages?
entries.inputs: Three manifest-pinned local device-patent cohorts and their typed source registries
entries.expected: Reject missing, unsupported, or mutated raw pages before parsing
entries.outcome: PASS: 24/24 pages mapped; raw size/hash and registry raw hash checks are enforced; mutation regression passes

entries.question: Can family metadata remain evaluator-side without altering runtime inputs?
entries.inputs: Separate mapping artifact, reference queries, and existing exact-group artifact
entries.expected: Family analysis reads a separate mapping and emits no runtime or evaluator relation payload
entries.outcome: PASS: runtime inputs unchanged; mapping builder emits no evaluator path or disclosure evidence fields; separation regression passes

entries.question: Does sourced family grouping change the current group partition?
entries.inputs: Five development reference queries and three final-holdout reference queries
entries.expected: Report exact and family-aware groups plus any cross-exact-group merges
entries.outcome: PASS: both splits retain 3 exact and 3 family-aware groups; 0 cross-group merges

entries.question: Did this package consume paid or provider resources?
entries.inputs: Offline local files and deterministic scripts only
entries.outcome: PASS: 0 provider calls, 0 network acquisition, 0 neural calls, $0.00 paid cost

decision: Family metadata is useful for provenance and uncertainty visibility, but this cohort does not support a changed group structure or a pooled scientific claim.
